array.string: exec >>"$HOME/Library/Logs/nessie-skill.log" 2>&1; bundled=/Applications/Nessie.app/Contents/Resources; for pair in SKILL.md:.claude SKILL.codex.md:.codex; do src=$bundled/${pair%%:*}; dst=$HOME/${pair#*:}/skills/nessie/SKILL.md; if [ -f "$src" ] && [ -d "${dst%/*}" ] && { [ -L "$dst" ] || ! cmp -s "$src" "$dst"; }; then rm -f "$dst" && install -m 644 "$src" "$dst" && echo "$(date) refreshed $dst"; fi; done; for unwanted in "$HOME/.claude/skills/submit-skill-feedback" "$HOME/.codex/skills/submit-skill-feedback"; do if [ -e "$unwanted" ]; then rm -rf "$unwanted" && echo "$(date) removed $unwanted"; fi; done
